messages:
sofia: seeing a spike in login failures + JIT provisioning errors for edu accounts, starting ~08:05 UTC. users end up with no roles. error in logs: `JITProvisioner: required_attr_missing: eduPersonScopedAffiliation`
sofia: example SAML assertion we get back (redacted):
```
<saml:Attribute Name="eduPersonScopedAffiliation"></saml:Attribute>
<saml:Attribute Name="mail">alice@uni.edu</saml:Attribute>
```
mike: any recent changes to sso-config or role-mapping?
jordan: pushed an RBAC refactor yesterday that tightened required attributes in sso-config -> `required_attributes: [eduPersonScopedAffiliation, mail]` as part of JIT hardening. I assumed Okta always returns eduPersonScopedAffiliation for our edu clients.
ava: ok, this matches. A subset of downstream IdPs don't send that attr (they send `eduPersonAffiliation` unscoped). our mapping code treats missing eduPersonScopedAffiliation as authoritative empty -> falls back to grant `org_admin` in legacy fallback. Not good. :grimacing: 
security-oncall: escalate: stop granting admin fallback immediately. We need to prevent privilege escalation while we patch.
mike: can we flip the fallback to `viewer` via config quickly? that'll stop admin grants.
jordan: yes. I have a tiny config change: `default_role: viewer` in sso-config and a guard in JIT to never auto-grant `org_admin` without explicit role claim. preparing a hotfix branch now.
sofia: also noticed some KMS binding failures for a few service accounts that rely on the JIT external_id mapping. looks related — if JIT doesn't persist external_id before role assign, the KMS policy binding step fails and leaves accounts without decrypt rights.
ava: confirmed in logs: `KMSBinder: missing_external_id -> abort bind for subject alice@uni.edu` around the same time as the JIT error. so two issues: attr missing -> role fallback bug, and race where KMS bind expects external id earlier.
mike: deploy-bot, can you run canary deploy with the hotfix to eng-dedicated? we want 10% traffic first.
deploy-bot: deploy started by jordan: branch fix/sso-jit-fallback-2065 -> canary group eng-dedicated-10pct. commit 7a3f2b8.
jordan: pushed hotfix: changes:
```
- required_attributes: [eduPersonScopedAffiliation, mail]
+ required_attributes: [mail]
+ default_role: viewer
+ guard: deny_auto_admin_without_claim: true
```
mike: rolling canary now. monitoring auth-errors and role assignment logs. watchlist: `JITProvisioner: required_attr_missing` and `KMSBinder: missing_external_id`.
sofia: also need an audit plan: backfill audit logs for the last 2 hours and create an incident record for any auto-assigned admin events. we must notify customers impacted (edu tenants).
security-oncall: I'll open an incident ticket and notify legal/compliance for potential sensitive admin exposures. add `audit: true` to the hotfix so every JIT path logs explicit before/after role assignment.
ava: on backfill: we can run a job to scan users provisioned in last 24h where `role in (org_admin)` and `source == sso` then revert to `viewer` and create change events. but let's not auto-revert until we confirm real claims.
mike: agree. start with a csv export and manual review for >50 users, automated reverts for obvious false-positives.
jordan: note re KMS: I'll change JIT to persist `external_id` to the user record before any external side effects (KMS bind, SCIM team adds). will add retries for KMSBinder.
sofia: timeline?
jordan: canary now, monitoring 15m. if green, promote in 30m and run backfill job in parallel.
mike: created CloudWatch/Datadog dashboard: `sso.jit.errors`, `sso.kms.bind_failures`, `sso.role_changes.auto_admin`. alert thresholds set low.
security-oncall: after rollout, we need a postmortem: root cause: overly strict required_attributes + legacy fallback granting admin. action items: (1) tighten tests for attribute absence, (2) remove admin fallback entirely, (3) ensure KMS bind atomicity, (4) customer notification template.
sofia: thanks everyone. ping me if any new auto-admin events show up. :thumbsup:
